title: Container cannot reach a service on the host through localhost, and host.docker.internal does not resolve on Linux
symptoms: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432 from inside the container
getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND host.docker.internal on Docker Engine for Linux
The same Compose file works on Docker Desktop for Mac
cause: Inside a container, localhost is the container itself. Docker Desktop resolves host.docker.internal on its own, but Docker Engine on Linux only does when you map the name to the special host-gateway value.
fix: Map host.docker.internal to host-gateway and make the host service listen on an address the bridge can reach. Between Compose services, connect by service name instead.
apply:
services:
  app:
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
# docker run: --add-host host.docker.internal=host-gateway
affected: Docker Engine on Linux, as of October 2026; Docker Desktop resolves the name by default
